scope: Whole-game forward planning requirements; no runtime or balance approval
dependency_rule: Owner/consumer mappings are planning responsibilities, not new DAG edges. Introducing features freeze their own contracts; T31/T33 validate integration downstream. Existing graph and ownership are unchanged.

requirement_origin_labels.CURRENT_USER_REQUIREMENT: Kaleb current explicit request, decomposed into testable forward obligations.
requirement_origin_labels.EXISTING_COMMITMENT_WITH_NEW_ACCEPTANCE_: Existing product/reference/economy commitments with explicit coverage details.
requirement_origin_labels.RECOMMENDED_PENDING_OWNER_FREEZE_AND_PLA: Authored recommendation, not observed reference or approved runtime balance.

requirements.title: Readable stakes and bounded recovery
requirements.obligation: Define each threat warning, cause, consequence, exposure limit, counterplay, recovery, grace/repeat/offline behavior and save semantics. Select the proposed loss policy explicitly; never present it as observed footage or implemented behavior.

requirements.title: Persistent loss, cargo and recovery integrity
requirements.obligation: Preserve authoritative cargo, purchase and recovery receipts through cancellation, defeat if designed, app suspension, crash, reconnect and migration; no duplicated payout/debit or repeated committed penalty.

requirements.title: Complete survivor assistance
requirements.obligation: Provide a trained/equipped survivor path for every physical human task family in ACTORS_MOTION_REQUIREMENTS.json. Specialization changes competence and preference; missing capabilities cannot silently become permanent exclusions.

requirements.title: Delegated plot funding and completion
requirements.obligation: Survivors physically contribute and complete player-approved plots/upgrades within a shared ordinary-resource/currency budget and protected reserves; recheck authorization and price at commit. No autonomous premium or real-money purchase.
required_evidence: Partial payment, cancellation and budget withdrawal

requirements.title: Useful large mixed survivor loads
requirements.obligation: Use shared typed custody and large useful mixed carrying with readable stacks. Preserve unlimited logical player inventory; explicitly reconcile finite/upgradable worker capacity before choosing its values.
required_evidence: Capacity-policy decision with real trip/throughput evidence
Upgrade and visual stack compression proof

requirements.title: Intelligent stable coordinated work
requirements.obligation: Implement the fourteen testable AI details in the actor contract: eligibility, stable priorities, shared reservations, safe preemption, player agency, route/target recovery, custody, fairness, survival awareness, truthful perception, save continuity, budgets and readable intent.
required_evidence: No duplicate claims or depleted-target loops
Stuck/abandoned-job evidence and measured busy-shift cost

requirements.title: Distinct useful seven-companion roster
requirements.obligation: Preserve seven species and existing authored capabilities; prove a distinct useful normal-play role per pet with meaningful player benefit and complete species motion. Recommended role emphases remain explicit authoring choices.

requirements.title: Friendly identity and legitimate target/loot eligibility
requirements.obligation: Separate friendly pets/survivors, wild prey and hostile entities by identity/faction/eligibility. Companion species art never implies friendly actors are harvestable or that each rendered meat cut must enter the food economy.

requirements.title: Full state/action/transition animation
requirements.obligation: Cover the twelve animation families, complete loops, transitions, contact, interruption, blocked/full/empty and resume states. Use justified static/shared dispositions where appropriate; no generic placeholder masquerades as finished action.
required_evidence: Action/state inventory linked to actual clips/mechanisms
Real-time and slow playback from distinct meaningful views

requirements.title: Meaningful machinery and logistics motion
requirements.obligation: Machines, belts, storage, defenses and vehicles visibly perform their actual function across idle/input/start/run/output/empty/full/blocked/damaged if designed/restart states. Preserve typed custody and real output transactions.

requirements.title: Readable enemy and combat variety
requirements.obligation: Each introduced enemy/weapon/locomotion archetype has authored intent, tell, attack, hit/miss, recovery and response states, with visible range/timing matching damage and meaningful counterplay.
required_evidence: No difficulty-only health or invisible damage substitution

requirements.title: Action-complete audio and accessible feedback
requirements.obligation: Feature owners emit truthful event phases; T54 freezes cue/mix/music/ambience or justified silence and listening evidence for each applicable event, variant and interruption. Critical information remains readable muted/reduced motion.
required_evidence: Actual listening under busy mixed activity
No success sound on denied/replayed transaction

requirements.title: Every shipped material has a meaningful purpose
requirements.obligation: Each introducing feature freezes acquisition, actual identity/alias, processing, primary use, payoff, demand, availability/cost, custody and surplus/retirement. T33 later validates the combined economy; it is not an added circular prerequisite to earlier producers.
required_evidence: Resource-value ledger and actual ID bindings
One demonstrable useful outcome per shipped ID

requirements.title: Resource and render reconciliation
requirements.obligation: Reconcile six canonical IDs, current-foundation IDs, thirteen base and twenty expansion render rows. Keep variants, containers and unselected concepts separate from canonical economy IDs; preserve all assets and decisions.
required_evidence: Current foundation coal/slate/metal, processed-output and cash gaps resolved by owner evidence
No recipe/drop/price inferred from a still

requirements.title: Clear currency and entitlement roles
requirements.obligation: Define earned ordinary money, exactly one primary premium currency, and any explicitly chosen temporary event token separately. XP is progression and VIP entitlement, not automatic currency. Actual cash must be persisted/collectible/spendable if represented as payment.
required_evidence: No mandatory paid recovery or basic AI competence
Event expiry/unspent balance decision before launch

requirements.title: Worthwhile collection and recoverable fair progression
requirements.obligation: Prove early/mid/late and low-resource routes at realistic free-player throughput; avoid circular inputs, stranded currencies, useless active inventory, deliberate drudgery or energy/pay recovery walls. A purposeful single-use quest item is valid with an explicit lifecycle.
required_evidence: Surplus/retirement and capped storage/worker-destination cases; preserve unlimited logical player inventory
No infinite conversion or intentional-failure reward loop

requirements.title: Integrated busy-shift and device proof
requirements.obligation: Measure concurrent working humans, pets, enemies, machines and deliveries with interruption/recovery on target devices. Visual/decision scaling preserves gameplay truth and readable attacks; planning checks cannot establish FPS or population capacity.
required_evidence: Sustained source-bound CPU/GPU/memory and frame evidence
No full-cost path recomputation for every idle actor

requirements.title: Full-game evidence and current acceptance
requirements.obligation: Close all applicable current requirements with exact-source evidence, independent review and existing reference>=9.9/visual exact10 rules. Pending design, placeholders, mere schema coverage and historical approvals do not certify current behavior.
required_evidence: Current candidate and selected render/video binding
All declared task scenarios and open-decision dispositions

design_decisions.title: Loss/recovery baseline
design_decisions.recommendation: Readable recoverable disruption, cargo recovery if selected, temporary down/repair/supply consequences; preserve free recovery. Default against permanent named-pet/survivor or purchased-progress loss and absence punishment.

design_decisions.title: Large worker carry capacity
design_decisions.recommendation: Substantial useful mixed loads and meaningful upgrades within shared typed custody; retain unlimited logical player inventory.
must_freeze: Finite/upgradable versus player-like worker logical policy
Visual stack aggregation and upgrade scaling

design_decisions.title: Exact material recipes and aliases
design_decisions.recommendation: Give every selected actual ID a useful phase-specific role; explicit defer/exclude is valid for unused concept art.

design_decisions.title: Pet role kits and active population
design_decisions.recommendation: Distinct useful species roles and tested team/population limits; no invented numeric buffs or mandatory paid competence.

design_decisions.title: Currency names, amounts and event expiry
design_decisions.recommendation: One ordinary earned-money role and one primary premium currency; temporary event tokens only when they add a selected purpose.

next_implementation_order: Resolve current gameplay owner/source; prepare shared typed custody/job/destination/reservation/plot-budget interfaces in existing permitted scopes.
Prove one complete interruptible survivor work+large-load+authorized-plot loop.
Prove each companion standalone useful behavior and full animation; integrate combined population in T31.
Freeze producer-specific resource value and full machine/event states before each producer; T33 validates combined economy later.
Run integrated failure/recovery and busy-shift scenarios across later regions and final acceptance.
source_precedence: The current 3fad812 source update supersedes specific historical Build11 cash/carry/drop/hearth observations; neither is runtime approval. Preserve all historical source artifacts.
